analysis: The PR changes one documentation file, docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The only change is a single added bullet at head line 1274, which says App Attest serving authorization can stay visible through its unexpired lease while MDM removal advice requires a matching fresh coordinator decision. It links to ../reference/provider-authorization.md. The supplied units (base lines 1695-2367) are unchanged surrounding context and contain no head-side change. I found no code, control, default, endpoint or key-handling change. The sentence is consistent with the threat model entries A-016, T-053 and T-057, which cover a cached authorization verdict versus a fresh coordinator decision and premature MDM removal. The documentation separates visible lease state from removal advice, which supports fail-safe guidance and does not weaken it. I could not verify two things: that the linked ../reference/provider-authorization.md exists in this repository, and that the doctor command implementation matches the described behavior. Both are outside the supplied evidence, so they are recorded here as unverified contracts rather than findings. No threat-model update is needed.
